concerns.text: FR-003 and US-003 require computing metadata statistics (cardinality, missingness, sparsity, variance) for correlation analysis. Tasks T024c (Aggregate to CSV) and T024e (Metadata Aggregation & Subset Selection) are marked as incomplete `[ ]`. Without these tasks completing, the `metadata_stats_summary.csv` artifact required by T015a, T025, T033, and T035 does not exist, creating a dead-lock that prevents satisfying FR-003 and FR-001 (denominator consistency).

concerns.text: FR-005 and FR-006 require statistical significance testing (t-test/Wilcoxon) and FDR correction. Tasks T031 (Recovery Ratio), T032a/b (Baseline Extraction), T034 (FDR), T035 (t-test), and T037 (Orchestration) are marked incomplete `[ ]`. These are the primary implementation tasks for the core research question (US-003). Their absence means the spec's success criteria (SC-001, SC-002, SC-003) cannot be met.

FR-001 mandates generating frozen embeddings for ALL datasets and re-computing the baseline. Task T015 (Generate Embeddings) and T015a (Single-Seed Baseline Classifier) are marked incomplete `[ ]`. While T013/T014 exist, the actual pipeline execution tasks to produce the required artifacts are missing implementation status, blocking the 'CPU-Conditioned' comparison in US-002.

FR-002 requires the projection layer implementation. Tasks T020/T021 (Tests), T022 (Projection Model), and T025 (Training Pipeline) are marked incomplete `[ ]`. Without T025, the 'CPU-Conditioned' performance metrics required for the Recovery Ratio (US-003) cannot be generated.

The spec's Edge Cases section explicitly requires handling zero-variance features. Task T061 (Zero-Variance Feature Handling Audit) is marked incomplete `[ ]`. While T045/T045b exist, the audit task to verify the handling is incomplete, leaving a gap in the verification of the edge case handling required by the spec.

Task T024 is marked `[X]` (Complete) with a note 'Deprecated - replaced by T024a, T024b, T024c'. However, T024c (the replacement for the aggregation step) is marked `[ ]` (Incomplete). This creates a confusing state where the 'parent' task is done but the actual work is not. The tag should be removed or the status corrected to reflect the incomplete state of the replacement tasks.
